name: adlc-skills
description: ADLC Skills: the Agentic Development Lifecycle as 47 skills, 28 commands and 2 agents across 8 plugins — from readiness and agent-ready specs to context engineering, agentic build, verification, governance, operations, and agent engineering.

plugins.name: adlc-foundations
plugins.description: ADLC foundations: readiness assessment on the DORA AI capabilities, SDLC-to-ADLC workflow mapping, agent autonomy levels, AI stance policy, ROI metrics, AI champions program, role transitions, and comprehension debt.

plugins.name: adlc-intent
plugins.description: Intent specification for coding agents: Agentic PRDs, spec-driven development, testable acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then, EARS), spec clarification, task decomposition, and architecture guardrails (ADRs, invariants, dependency rules).

plugins.name: adlc-context
plugins.description: Context engineering for coding agents: CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md authoring and audits, codebase maps, context-window budgeting, codifying conventions as skills, hooks or tests, MCP integration planning, and evidence-based skill library management.

plugins.name: adlc-build
plugins.description: Agentic construction at the system level: choosing and composing execution frameworks with one owner per slot, long-running and multi-agent work design, small-batch delivery policy, and legacy modernization strategy with behavior parity.

plugins.name: adlc-verify
plugins.description: Verification of agent-built software: review capacity design for the agent-PR bottleneck, behavioral testing, tests derived from specs, alignment review of agent PRs, hallucination checks, and a Definition of Done for agent work.

plugins.name: adlc-govern
plugins.description: Governance and security for agentic development: OWASP Agentic Top 10 threat modeling, auto-mode-era agent permissions, guardrail hooks, compliance mapping (ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, SOC 2), extension vetting, and governance for non-engineers building with AI.

plugins.name: adlc-operate
plugins.description: Operating the ADLC: release gates, Continuous AI background workflows, AgentOps observability, AI cost management, a learning loop from rejected agent work, and blameless agent incident reviews.

plugins.name: adlc-agent-engineering
plugins.description: Agent engineering for teams building AI agents and LLM features: architecture patterns, tool design, eval suites, prompts as versioned code, and runtime guardrails.
